title: Repair Window Terms for In-Place Home Resale Re-Inspections
content:
**Repair window.** The visit fee of a coming re-inspection on an In-Place Home Resale file follows the calendar days from the date of the most recent inspection on the file to the day the visit is booked:

- after more than 60 days the repairs window has lapsed and the visit is a full inspection of every standards item, so the package's inspection fee takes the place of the items fee in the visit-fee sum;
- after more than the package's repairs period (30 calendar days on every package) but no more than 60 days, the visit is a late re-inspection and the visit-fee sum is multiplied by 1.5;
- within the package's repairs period of 30 days, the visit fee is the visit-fee sum itself.

The visit fee is then rounded half up to the cent.

**Terms.** The *most recent inspection* is the latest inspection recorded on the file by record date, initial or re-inspection. The *days* are the booking day less that inspection's record date. The *visit-fee sum* is the items fee and the surcharges the coming visit carries, added together.

| Days from the most recent inspection to booking | Visit fee |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | the visit-fee sum |
| 31 to 60 | the visit-fee sum multiplied by 1.5 |
| 61 or more | the package's inspection fee plus the surcharges, in place of the items fee plus the surcharges |

## Worked figures (hypothetical visit: items fee 95.00, surcharges 30.00 and 35.00, so a visit-fee sum of 160.00)

| Days since the most recent inspection | Visit fee |
|---|---|
| 30 | 160.00 |
| 31 | 160.00 multiplied by 1.5, 240.00 |
| 60 | 240.00 |
| 61, package inspection fee 125.00 | 125.00 plus 65.00, 190.00 |
| 61, package inspection fee 0.00 | 0.00 plus 65.00, 65.00 |
